acceptance.given: The six Matrix Cases are defined with distinct inputs and subject identifiers in the Toolchain evaluation artifacts.

oracle.expected: A matrix aggregate artifact records executions for both required subjects across all six Matrix Cases.
forbidden: The aggregate records executions for only one subject.
Any required Matrix Case execution is absent from the aggregate.
oracle.observable: The aggregate Matrix Case result and its per-case subject fields are inspected after the matrix run.

acceptance.then: The aggregate records executions covering both subjects.
acceptance.when: Run the six-case Matrix evaluation and inspect the aggregate execution record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the six-case Matrix aggregate assertion and verify that at least one required subject is omitted from the recorded executions.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure the six Matrix Case aggregate records executions for both subjects, with each case retaining its distinct input identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Matrix Case result schema and reject incomplete aggregates without changing prior valid records.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix aggregate moves from pending/unverified subject coverage to a recorded six-case result covering both subjects.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The six-case aggregate contains subject identifiers for both required subjects and no required case is missing.

acceptance.given: The assembled Atomic Obligations and their witness requirements are available to the governance validator.

oracle.expected: Validation records a required witness for every Atomic Obligation and reports complete witness coverage.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation lacks a required witness.
oracle.observable: The validator's witness-coverage output is inspected for a complete one-to-one obligation-to-witness mapping.

acceptance.then: 100% of Atomic Obligations have their required witnesses recorded.
acceptance.when: Run SM-1 witness validation and inspect its coverage artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the SM-1 witness-coverage assertion and verify that an Atomic Obligation without a required witness is reported as a validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require bidirectional Exact Cover witness records so every Atomic Obligation has its required witness and incomplete coverage is rejected.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing obligation and witness identifiers stable; only tighten validation of missing or orphaned witnesses.

slice_hint.state_transition: Atomic Obligations move from awaiting witness validation to complete bidirectional witness coverage.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The coverage artifact contains exactly one required witness mapping for every Atomic Obligation and no missing witness is accepted.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result is marked successful and includes a snapshot reference plus the Validator Capability, dependencies, command, Probe, output, Consumer, and non-authority binding fields.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independently recomputed verification of the referenced snapshot and all required SM-5 binding fields.
forbidden: The snapshot is not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
The result relies only on an unverified snapshot reference or omits a required binding field.
oracle.observable: The successful Replay Result artifact is inspected for an independent snapshot verification record and the complete SM-5 field set.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result independently verifies the snapshot.
acceptance.when: Evaluate a successful Replay Result and independently inspect or recompute its snapshot binding during replay-result validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the SM-5 successful Replay Result assertion and verify that a result lacking independent snapshot verification is rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful Replay Results to independently verify snapshot content and preserve the complete SM-5 binding set before acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Replay Result field names and backward-compatible successful records while rejecting records without independent snapshot verification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay Result moves from successful-but-unverified snapshot state to successful with independently verified snapshot and complete bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful Replay Result is accepted only when independent snapshot verification and every SM-5 binding field are present.

acceptance.given: A fresh checkout is created with the pinned inputs, source package, validator, fixtures, and command definitions required by NFR-3.

oracle.expected: The coverage result produced in the fresh checkout matches the pinned-input baseline coverage result.
forbidden: The coverage result differs from the pinned-input baseline.
The coverage result cannot be reproduced from the pinned inputs in a fresh checkout.
oracle.observable: The fresh-checkout replay output is compared field-for-field with the pinned-input baseline coverage result.

acceptance.then: The fresh checkout produces the same coverage result as the pinned-input baseline.
acceptance.when: Execute the pinned inputs in a fresh checkout and compare the resulting coverage artifact with the pinned-input baseline.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the fresh-checkout replay comparison and verify that a coverage result differing from the pinned-input baseline is reported as a reproducibility failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make fresh-checkout replay recompute the coverage result from pinned inputs and compare it deterministically with the pinned-input baseline.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve pinned-input and coverage-result schemas; rollback only the reproducibility comparison logic if compatibility regressions occur.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fresh checkout moves from unestablished reproducibility to a coverage result matching the pinned-input baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh-checkout coverage output is byte or field equivalent to the pinned-input baseline and validation reports no reproducibility divergence.
